theorems.name: Submission.bf_infiniteFibre_projection_null
theorems.statement: (∀ (N m k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ (A : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith L f → ∃ g : Rn m → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ (∀ y, μHE[k] (A ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}) ≤ g y) ∧ ∫⁻ y, g y ≤ ((C * L ^ m : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[m + k] A) → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ))), finrank ℝ W = n → ∀ A : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), μHE[n] A < ∞ → μHE[n] (W.starProjection '' {a | a ∈ A ∧ {b | b ∈ A ∧ W.starProjection b = W.starProjection a}.Infinite}) = 0
